description:
Record a vineyard maturity check for 'Block 9 Pinot Noir'. Create a new Observation log dated September 14, 2024. In the notes, enter: 'Pre-harvest maturity sample. Berries fully colored, seeds brown, skins softening. Flavor profile shows red fruit notes.'

Add the following three quantities to the log:
1. Value: 24.2, Label: Sugar Content, Unit: Brix
2. Value: 3.55, Label: Acidity, Unit: pH
3. Value: 5.8, Label: Titratable Acidity, Unit: g/L

Save the log and ensure it appears in the list.
